meta.name: cyberedge-observe-websites
meta.description: Collect bounded HTTP metadata, response evidence, and verified technology fingerprints from Web services in an explicitly authorized CyberEdge scope.

copy.tagline: 收集授权范围内的Web服务元数据与指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要收集授权Web服务的技术指纹与元数据
copy.tagline_en: Collect metadata and fingerprints from authorized web services
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect technical fingerprints and metadata from authorized web services

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能够从你明确授权的网站收集 HTTP 元数据、响应快照以及已验证的技术指纹。
howto.when: 当你已经有一个非空的授权范围（Scope），并且你要求 Claude 观察该范围内的网站时触发。

say.text: 请观察我授权范围内的网站。
say.note: Claude 会收集该范围内的网站信息。

say.text: 查看授权网站的技术指纹。
检查授权网站是否有主机冲突。
say.note: Claude 会进行主机冲突检测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can collect HTTP metadata, response snapshots, and verified technology fingerprints from web services within an authorized CyberEdge scope.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a non-empty authorized scope and ask Claude to observe websites within that scope.

say_en.text: Observe the websites in my authorized scope.
say_en.note: Claude will collect website information for that scope.

say_en.text: Check the technology fingerprints of my authorized websites.
say_en.note: Claude will return detections like WordPress or Grafana.

say_en.text: Check for host collisions on my authorized websites.
say_en.note: Claude will run host collision checks.
